description: Qase test management (app.qase.io) via the official @qase/mcp-server run locally over stdio: projects, suites, test cases, test plans, runs and results, defects, milestones, shared steps; QQL search across cases/runs/results/defects; qase_api as a raw REST escape hatch. Acts as the operator's Qase user via a personal API token (QASE_API_TOKEN in .env).
